verdict.rationale: Knowledge bases and RAG are a fair question for a voice-agent builder like Bolna, but the evidence pack never mentions a knowledge base, document upload or retrieval grounding. The nearest items are generic ready-to-use tools and a custom OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint. Those are adjacent features and developer building blocks, not a built-in knowledge base, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content
